newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold trade surges on post-holiday demand.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold trade surges on post-holiday demand.

text.p: Trade on the Istanbul gold exchange picked up sharply on Thursday with volume jumping to 2,602 kilos from 845 kilos on Tuesday, the last day of trading.
Gold closed easier at $341.90 an ounce and 1,476,000 lira per gram, compared to $343.70 and 1,484,600 on Tuesday in line with European markets, dealers said.

"Gold demand was high as the exchange was closed for much of this week and prices were lower. Free-market traders wanted to make up for stocks sold over the holiday. There may also be some seasonal demand as summer approaches," one dealer said.
The gold exchange was closed for a 4-1/2-day religious holiday from April 17, then opened on Tuesday before closing on Wednesday for a further national holiday.
Of the day's trade, 942 kilos took place in the morning session, with 62.5 percent of total trade in lira terms. -- Istanbul newsroom +90-212-2750875.
